semantics: many-sorted partial algebra with empty extension sorts permitted
conditions: base and extension sort names are disjoint
base generators and laws are unchanged
every new constructor is partial or has a new-sort output
every new equation contains at least one extension symbol
forgetting extension sorts and symbols yields the original base model
every base model has an empty expansion with all extension domains empty

forgetful_projection.action: discard boundary_datum, filler, relative_class, completed_filler and every incident extension symbol
forgetful_projection.law: U preserves base sorts, generators, cells, and laws identically

empty_expansion.action: interpret all four extension sorts as empty and all extension constructors as empty partial maps
empty_expansion.law: U composed with E0 is identity on Model(base)

relative_universal_property: For a base model B and specified extension data D over B satisfying the layer laws, interpretations of the extended signature over B are exactly law-preserving realizations of D.
scope: Finite declared signature only; no claim of homotopical localization, model-category presentation, or unbounded higher-categorical universality.
